links.outcome: GenAI infection classification accuracy versus manual chart review reference standard
links.effect: Specificity 100% (50/50 uninfected correct); all 50 infections identified but timing/attribution incorrect in 7 of 50; sensitivity for timing and attribution 82%.
links.quote: The overall specificity of the GenAI-assisted process was 100% and the sensitivity for accurately classifying timing and attribution of CIED infection events was 82%.

links.outcome: Errors in GenAI outputs requiring manual adjudication
links.effect: Timing and attribution to preceding procedure incorrect in 7 of 50 infection cases; authors conclude manual adjudication of output is needed.
links.quote: Among 50 infection cases, GenAI identified all CIED infections, but the timing of events and the attribution to a preceding procedure were incorrect in 7 of 50 cases.

unlisted_practices: Iterative prompt refinement to reduce extraction errors
LLM-assisted chart review for healthcare-associated infection surveillance to reduce review time

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM-assisted infection surveillance on clinical notes, showing how iterative prompt refinement and manual adjudication affect review time and accuracy.

primary.practice: iterative prompt refinement and manual adjudication
